title: FeedItem
description: One row of GET /api/v1/feed (T-034, 03 §2.8): a published share with its (public-only) sharer, the source post to link out to, the crediting influencer, and the place it published.

sharer.description: Null when the sharer's profile is private — the feed row still renders, unattributed.

url.description: The canonical post URL to link out to. Always present — `source_posts.url` is NOT NULL.

caption.description: Truncated to 200 characters for the card.

influencer.description: The account credited for the original post, null when the post has none.

place.description: The published pin, as the same summary card the map and browse list use.
